content: Raḡan damonama matairidima
Yesu tempol ya gose da ya naḡonaḡo be na tauwai muriwatanama ḡarone a tavana. Dabudine taudi tempol a kita virevire, Yesu ai katai be a basebasena.
Be dabudine Yesu taudi ya riuedina, “Yà riuriu kauemina da uma yabedima matabudi yodi ko kitekitedina, tokare nam nama ta kena nonoḡa ibewa, be matabudi tokare ta rawadabu ririḡidina.”

Yesu oya Olip debane ya miamia be na tauwai muriwatanama taudiḡa Yesu ḡarone a tava da ai taravire, be a riuna, “Kwa riuemai, uma kauidima aba raḡanine ta tubuḡa? Be abaḡa matairidima ta tubuḡa da ka kitedi be ka kataie da raḡan damonama kaiteka maida, be mate nema ka katai bake da tam am kaba verauma raḡaninama e tavatava?”
Be Yesu ya riuna, “Koi kita kaua da nam aitau ei kedadoka waigewemi.
Baninama banaga toitoi tokare isague ta tava be ta riuna, ‘Taugu vutuna Keriso!’ Be taudi tokare banaga toitoi tai kedadoka waigewedina.
Be raḡanine iḡara maida guguridima ko vaie bo madanie varidima ko vaiedina, nam ko naira! Uma kauidima nama tokare ta tubuḡana, be inam nam raḡan damona, ibewa!
Dobu da dobu tai kawa ḡasiḡasina, be waiguyau turanama waiguyau mate tai kawa ḡasiḡasina. Be dobu toitoi nopodie meiḡara be yoyo tai verautatena.
Inam kauidima maika kaipakara gomana kaevounama e tepetepena tunimuyanama maika, inam tepa pakanama.

“Inam raḡanine taumi tokare ta panimi be babada nimedie ta biri nawemi da taudi ta raukivi gewegewemi be tai gurimina. Be taumi taugu kowai sumaḡeguna aubainama, banaga dobu matabuna tokare ta tuaḡaiemina.
Inam raḡanine banaga toitoi adi waisumaḡama ta gosedi be adi banagama adi banagama ta tuaḡaiedi be tai kawa biri dobiḡana,
be peroveta kaikaiyovudima toitoi inam raḡanine ta maḡatara, be banaga toitoi tai kedadoka waigewedina.
Be gewagewa e moraba, be banaga toitoi adi wainuapaḡoma tokare ei kavena.
Be aitauḡa adi waisumaḡe ta midi bagibagi be ta raudamoena, taudi tokare ta yawasanana.
Be Mamaitua na waiguyauma varinama verenama tokare dobue banaga matabudi ḡarodie ta rauguguya nawe da banaga ta vaie, muriḡa da raḡan damonama e tavana.

“Taumi tausiava, uma giunama baninama ko katai kauena, Peroveta Daniel ya riuna da tokare ko kitana gewagewa waimatawarawara vavasaḡinama deḡo nam sibo ya midi, be tokare e midina. Inam kauinama e tubuḡana raḡanine,
taudi aitauḡa Judiama miemienidima naumeki da naira oyae sibo a naḡona.
Inam raḡanine, aitau da na wagapatae
e miamiana, nam vadama nopone e saḡa be na purapurama e ragaudi.
Be nam aitau sipie be na garama ragaudima aubaidima e munaḡa vadae.
Inam raḡandie waiwaivi bogebogedima be waitatau vaudima, taudi tokare piripiri dosidima ta banavidina.
Be Mamaitua ḡarone ko moiragi da inam raḡandima, nam bodubodue
bo Sabat raḡandie ta tubuḡa, baninama taumi tokare nema naira ko naḡo bako?

Baninama nuaboya inam raḡandie e gewagewa vavasaḡana tokare ta tubuḡana. Mamaitua dobu yawai tubuḡie da yodi, nam airaḡan uma piripiridima ti tubuḡa rubuna naumeki da yodi. Be uma piripiridima murine nam airaḡan e tubuḡa munaḡa.
Be deḡoda Mamaitua inam piripiri raḡandima tai tupodima ibewa, nam aitau tenaḡa tokare ya yawasana. Be na banagama vinevinedima kadi taiye, tauna uma raḡandima tokare e taitupodina.
Be inam raḡandie deḡoda aitau e riuemina, ‘Keriso umanema!’ bo e riuna, ‘Keriso noanema!’ Inam baneginama nam koi sumaḡe!

Baninama Keriso kaikaiyovudima, be peroveta kaikaiyovudima tokare ta maḡatara be mataira be anibasa kauidima ta voiedina, be ta raurubu da Mamaitua na vinevinema banegidima mate sibo ai kedadoka waigewedina.
Vutuna aubainama ko kita kauana, yaba matabuna kaite è riu wainonoḡimina, muriḡa da inam raḡandima ta tavana.
“Vutuna aubainama deḡoda aitau e riuemina, ‘Noanema Keriso, dobu kavakavane.’ Nam ko dobi ko naḡo! Bo deḡoda e riuemina, ‘Keriso umanema vadae.’ Nam koi sumaḡe!
Baninama Banaga Natunama na raḡanima ei raḡantenaḡe be keyama maika e kidi, be gunuma matabuna e yana porena.
Deḡo musara gurinama e kenakenana, dabudine naboduba
ta rawarawa teḡeidina.
“Be inam piripiridima raḡandima muridie,

content.text: suara ei kupi, be nawaravi tokare nam e yana munaḡa.
Be gunuma rewapanidima matabudi e gusu waidaberaridi be kipora gunume ta kuruvana.

content: Inam raḡanine noḡone Banaga Natunama tokare gunume e maḡatara, da banaga ta kita be ta kataie da inam Banaga Natunama e yovoyovona. Be dobue banaga matabudi tai sosori be ta ḡabana. Be tokare taudi Banaga Natunama rewapana be neneḡara dosinama mate giyou nopone be e yovoyovona ta kitana.
Dabudine bogigi dosinama e riuriuna raḡanine, tauna na aneama e riuporedi da na banagama vinevinedima matabudi dobu isune da isune, be gunuma isune da isune, da ta rawateḡeteḡeidina.
Bada na kaba verauma raḡanima nam aitau i kataiena
“Naumeki da damaya kainama ko kita be ḡarone ko kataina. Raḡanine damaya ragedima ta kini, be rugudima ta gidagidavana, inam raḡanine ko kataie da inam bodubodu raḡaninama maida e tavatavana.
Inam kauinama teneḡinama nama, raḡanine taumi inam kauidima gewegewedima ta tubutubuḡana ko kitedina, dabudine taumi ko kataie da Bada na kaba verauma raḡaninama kaiteka maida.
Taugu yà riuriu kauemina, da uma kimtinama nam ei kave, naumeki da inam kauidima tokare matabudi ta tubuḡa dokana.
Mara be dobu tokare ta samoana, be taugu riuguma nam airaḡan e samoa.
Nam aitau tenaḡa raḡan i kataiena da airaḡan inam raḡaninama e tava. Nam anea marae, Mamaitua Natunama mate nam i kataiena, be Tamanama marae taunaḡa ya kataiena.
“Banaga Natunama na raḡanima maika Noa na raḡanie yawasana a tubutubuḡana maika.
Muriḡa da kabaita ya tubuḡana, banaga a kanikani, a tegotego, ai naḡi be awai naḡidina. Nama a voivoia be Noa waga ak nopone ya saḡana.

Be banaga tokare aba ḡarodie e tubuḡana, taudi nam ti kataiena. Naumeki da kabaita ya tubutubuḡana, taudi matabudi ya karuedi be upa nopone a tonedina. Inam kauinama nama tokare Banaga Natunama na kaba veraue e tubuḡana.
Inam raḡanine tautauḡoma rabui ta sipisipi be tenaḡa tokare anea ta nawena, be tenaḡa ta gosena.
Be waiwaivi rabui kani ta rarau suvi, be tenaḡa tokare anea ta nawena, be tenaḡa ta gosena.
“Vutuna aubainama raḡan matabuna koi neneḡanana, baninama ami Badama na kaba verauma raḡanima nam ko kataiena.
Uma ko noḡoti, deḡoda vada taupakinama sibo taudanedanene na kaba tavama raḡaninama i kataiena, naumeki da tauna tokare na gaburama ya bodame, be baneginama nam na vadae ya saḡa be ya danene.
Vutuna aubainama taumi mate ko vokaukaua be ko miamia, baninama Banaga Natunama na kaba verauma, taumi tokare ko miamia nuababaḡa be e tavana.
“Ai taunoya tauna waisumeḡina be nuanuauyauyana, da Bada sibo tauna ya vine? Inam taunoyanama na banagama e rabedi be adi kanima e soiedina, taudi ta ḡoeḡoena raḡanine.
“Raḡanine na Badama e tava munaḡa be e kitana da na taunoyama na noyama e voivoiena, naumeki da nuavere dosinama inam taunoyanama ḡarone.
Yà riuriu kauemina da Bada na purapurama matabudi tokare inam taunoyanama e ute, be tauna ei badedina.
Be taunoya deḡoda e gewagewa be e riuna, ‘Bada bonideḡo ya naḡo be e miamia watanana.’
Be dabudine tauna na banagama e riḡedi be tegobua banegidima mate ta kanikani, ta tegotego buana.
Nama e voivoia nuababaḡa be na badama e tavana.
Inam raḡanine Bada inam taunoya gewagewanama e dourakaraka be banaga kaikaiyovudima adi gabue e boru nawena. Be dabudine tokare ta yakei be gadigadidima ta sanadidi watanedina.

footnotes.text: Jius banegidima adi vadama debanama inam ‘wagapata’ maika tabatabanama. Dabudine adi kaba waimiamiama.
Gurik baibol nopone nam ‘bodubodu’ ima kenakenana. Be ‘winter’ e kenakenana, inam nam maika bodubodu, be inam tururu ya moraba kauana, tokare teneteneḡinama ei gurimna.
‘Naboduba’ inam maika kiu isanama ‘vulture’. Taudi musara deḡo e gurina, waiḡapa dabudi ta tavana. Be matabudi a kataiena da musara deḡo dabudi e kenakenana.
